+import os
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+def _parse_iso8601(value: str) -> datetime:
+    value = value.strip()
+    if value.endswith("Z"):
+        value = value[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    return datetime.fromisoformat(value)
+
+
+def _default_window_minutes() -> int:
+    raw = os.getenv("LOGTAIL_WINDOW_MINUTES", "60")
+    try:
+        return max(1, int(raw))
+    except ValueError:
+        return 60
+
+
+def _build_query(severity: str, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> dict:
+    query = (
+        f'severity:{severity} AND timestamp:["{start.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()}" '
+        f'TO "{end.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()}"]'
+    )
+    return {
+        "query": query,
+        "from": start.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "to": end.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "limit": 100,
+    }
+
+
+def fetch_error_logs(severity: str, start: datetime, end: datetime):
+    api_key = os.getenv("LOGTAIL_SOURCE_TOKEN")
+    source_token = os.getenv("LOGTAIL_LOG_SOURCE_TOKEN")
+    if not api_key or not source_token:
+        raise RuntimeError("LOGTAIL_SOURCE_TOKEN and LOGTAIL_LOG_SOURCE_TOKEN are required")
+
+    url = f"https://api.logtail.com/v1/sources/{source_token}/search"
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=_build_query(severity, start, end), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    return payload.get("data", payload)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    severity = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.getenv("LOG_SEVERITY", "error")
+    end = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    window_minutes = _default_window_minutes()
+    start = end - timedelta(minutes=window_minutes)
+
+    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
+        start = _parse_iso8601(sys.argv[2])
+    if len(sys.argv) > 3:
+        end = _parse_iso8601(sys.argv[3])
+
+    logs = fetch_error_logs(severity, start, end)
+    if isinstance(logs, list):
+        for entry in logs:
+            print(entry)
+    else:
+        print(logs)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: write_correlated_logs.py
+import logging
+import os
+import sys
+import uuid
+
+import requests
+
+
+def _configure_logger() -> logging.Logger:
+    logger = logging.getLogger("correlated_logs")
+    logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
+    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
+    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(message)s"))
+    logger.handlers.clear()
+    logger.addHandler(handler)
+    logger.propagate = False
+    return logger
+
+
+def _emit_log(logger: logging.Logger, provider: str, correlation_id: str, event: str, **fields) -> None:
+    payload = {
+        "provider": provider,
+        "correlation_id": correlation_id,
+        "event": event,
+        **fields,
+    }
+    logger.info(payload)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    logger = _configure_logger()
+    correlation_id = os.getenv("CORRELATION_ID", str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    provider = "requests"
+
+    _emit_log(logger, provider, correlation_id, "request_started", method="GET", url="https://httpbin.org/get")
+
+    response = requests.get("https://httpbin.org/get", headers={"X-Correlation-ID": correlation_id}, timeout=10)
+
+    _emit_log(
+        logger,
+        provider,
+        correlation_id,
+        "request_completed",
+        status_code=response.status_code,
+        response_bytes=len(response.content),
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+def write_structured_log(event_name: str, severity: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ["DYNATRACE_API_TOKEN"]
+    environment_id = os.environ["DYNATRACE_ENVIRONMENT_ID"]
+    endpoint = f"https://{environment_id}.live.dynatrace.com/api/v2/logs/ingest"
+    record = {
+        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "event_name": event_name,
+        "severity": severity,
+        "payload": payload,
+        "provider": "dynatrace",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        endpoint,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Api-Token {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps([record]),
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return record
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    write_structured_log(
+        event_name="structured_log_written",
+        severity="INFO",
+        payload={"status": "ok"},
+    )
*** End Patch
